//: This file is read from /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json at HIGHEST precedence.
Values here override user and project settings. Engineers cannot change these.

permissions.//: Disable bypass mode to prevent nullifying the entire permission model.
Even with container isolation, bypass mode lets Claude read .env, .pem,
and other denied files. Set to 'allow' only if you accept that risk.
Default permission mode for Claude Code sessions.
Options: 'default' (prompt for each action), 'auto' (classifier reviews actions).
Deny rules prevent Claude from reading/writing sensitive files.
The .devcontainer/** rule (from trailofbits) prevents Claude from
reading or modifying its own sandbox configuration.
